title: Opera 64, 1804 — Quartetto Primo … Boccherini
established_by: Official scan commissioned from the Library of Congress. Title page reads '1804 // Opera 64. // Quartetto Primo // Violino Primo // Boccherini'. RISM does not catalogue this copy -- see rism_catalogues_this_copy_note. Filed 2026-09-28.
rism_related_note: RISM's records for the same two works at other libraries -- DK-Km '(R454)'/'(R455)', US-CA Harvard 'fMS Mus 6', and F-Pn 'Vma ms 1067 (5)'/'(6)'. None of them is this copy. Corrected 2026-09-29: an earlier version of this note claimed RISM catalogued GerB 248-249 only at DK-Km and Harvard, and that this was the project's only copy of the two works. Both were wrong -- F-Pn Vma ms 1067 carries them too, and that copy is now held at digitizations/G248/840022759_F-Pn and G249/840022760_F-Pn.
rism_catalogues_this_copy_note: RISM records 24 US-Wc holdings across the quartet corpus. Every one is 'M452.A2 B67 Case' or carries no shelfmark; 'M452.A2 B68 Case' appears nowhere. RISM does not catalogue this manuscript, so there is no source record to link it to.
arrived_as_note: Supplied as a finished PDF, not collated here from page images, so there are no filenames whose meaning could be lost. `page_index` does not apply.
pages_note: 32 pp for G 248 and 16 for G 249, one leaf per page. The purchased capture had 34 openings of two leaves each, wrapper included.
dedication: Composti espressamente per il Cittadino Luciano Bonaparte

processed.what: blank leaves and the wrapper removed by hand, 30 September 2026
processed.from: Boccherini G.248-249 - Opus 64 Numbers 1-2 - Library of Congress - M452.A2 B68 Case.pdf

note: Two PDFs, one per quartet, processed by hand from the purchased Library of Congress capture: the wrapper and the blank leaves removed and each opening split into its two leaves. The unprocessed original is no longer in the archive -- see ~/.Trash/boccherini-loc-unprocessed-2026-09-30/ for its checksum and page count. page-index.md maps every page here back to the opening and side it came from; derivation.json is the machine-readable form.
files_note: One PDF per work, each containing all four parts in order. Named with a hyphen, not a dot: a dot in the stem is this archive's convention for a part-book file, and the audit counts those to spot an incomplete set.
rism_related_established_by: rism_related_note on this folder: the six linked records are DK-Km (R454)/(R455), US-CA fMS Mus 6 and F-Pn Vma ms 1067 (5)/(6), none of them this copy; RISM does not catalogue M452.A2 B68.
